newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Zalakeramia approves capital raise plan.
newsitem.headline: Zalakeramia approves capital raise plan.

text.p: Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia Rt's shareholders approved a capital increase at an extraordinary general meeting called for Wednesday to discuss issues related to planned acquisitions.

"Shareholders approved the plan of the private capital increase in a way that the number of new ordinary shares would be at least 900,000 and no more than 1,200,000," Zalakeramia's General Director Gyorgy Katona told Reuters.

Katona said Zalakeramia would hold another extraordinary general meeting in March to ask shareholder approval for necessary amendments in the company statutes and to mark those entitled for subscribing to the new shares and to mandate the board to implement the capital increase.
Credit Suisse First Boston and Raiffeisen Zentral Bank will act as co-lead managers in the transaction.

In an earlier statement Zalakeramia said it would use a bridging loan to finance one of its planned acquisitions as it was likely to be completed before the capital increase. Katona said the amount of the loan would be roughly 20 million German marks.

Zalakeramia said in January it was planning acquisitions. To finance these purchases the board was seeking shareholders' approval for the issue of new ordinary shares, to be offered privately to Hungarian and foreign institutional investors.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Zalakeramia shares finished steady at 9,000 forints.
